'''Ubed Yalla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who resided on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the settlement of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]]. At some point in [[3643 BBY]], she trained a rising [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] who would later go on to earn the title of [[Barsen'thor]].
